trust_decision.summary: Whether an authenticated caller may overwrite process-global LLM/vector-DB config is decided (after the fix) by a user.is_superuser check inside the POST /api/v1/settings handler; at the pinned commit no check exists, so any authenticated user reaches save_llm_config/save_vector_db_config.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'overwrite global LLM configuration'; the only HTTP route writing global LLM config is the settings POST handler, mounted at /api/v1/settings (cognee/api/client.py:257).

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No second implementation reachable remotely: the other writers of global LLM/vector config are the in-process SDK cognee.config setters (cognee/api/v1/config/config.py:283-320) and the local CLI (cognee/cli/commands/config_command.py:140), neither exposed over HTTP or MCP.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The only other writers of global config (cognee.config SDK setters and the `cognee config` CLI) run in the operator's own process with operator privileges, so leaving them alone is legitimately correct, not a solver error.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: GET /api/v1/settings must stay available to any authenticated user (frontend reads it), and with REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATION=false the fallback default user is a superuser, so POST must keep working in no-auth mode; gating GET or gating on 'is authenticated' breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: payload with both (single handler-level check covers all)

O7_producer.where: Config objects are mutated in place by get_llm_config()/get_vectordb_config() singletons (cognee/modules/settings/save_llm_config.py:12); no schema/serializer/cache producer involved in the decision.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted 'apply stored principal configuration to runtime' step that pushes a user's stored llm_* keys into the global LLM config without a superuser check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The router already stores per-user 'LLM settings' dicts (examples at :26, :35); a maintainer wiring 'apply my config' would naturally call cognee.config setters, a where-type sibling only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An HTTP route exposing cognee.config.set_llm_config/set_embedding_config (e.g. embedding endpoint/api_key) without the superuser gate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Embedding config is equally global and the SDK already has dict-based setters; a 'settings v2' route adding embedding fields is plausible. Still a where-type sibling of one concept.

O9_family: Missing authorization on an admin-only global configuration write (CWE-306 / broken access control)

O10_build.toolchain: Python 3.10+ with uv/pip (pyproject), FastAPI + fastapi-users, SQLite default relational DB
O10_build.project_tests: No settings-authorization tests at the pinned commit; the fix adds cognee/tests/api/test_settings_authorization.py (fix.diff:224-314) using FastAPI TestClient with REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATION=true.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if not user.is_superuser: 403` at the top of save_settings — which is the complete correct fix.

out_of_scope_notes: GET /api/v1/settings returns the first 10 chars of the LLM and vector-DB keys to any authenticated user (cognee/modules/settings/get_settings.py:94, :184-187); a full mask was added in d10b1b and reverted in 10971db, and is not part of the net fix.
Public self-registration stays enabled (cognee/api/v1/users/routers/get_register_router.py:5-6); the opt-out env gate was added and then reverted inside the fix commit range.
GET /api/v1/configuration/get_user_configuration/{config_id} fetches by id with no owner check (cognee/api/v1/users/routers/get_configuration_router.py:94).
unverified: Net effect of the three fix commits is read as: d10b1b (earlier fix) was reverted by 10971db, and ebcf824 alone is the effective change against the pinned tree; the pinned register router and get_settings masking match the reverted state, which is consistent with this reading.
